abstract: The purposes of this research were 1) to study effect of using Facebook based on constructivist teaching method to develop English writing dexterity of undergraduate students in Thailand, 2) to compare undergraduate students' English writing achievement before and after writing activities, and 3) to compare English writing achievement of controlled group and experimental group. The subjects were 40 undergraduate students at Thai-Nichi Institute of Technology during first semester of 2017 academic year which derived through simple random sampling technique. The instruments used in this experiment were the pre-post English writing test, the English writing lesson plans based on constructivist and the English writing ability evaluation form. The experimental process and data collection were conducted as follows: The subjects were given an English writing ability pretest. Then, the six lesson plans were used in first semester. After the completion of each lesson, the English writing ability evaluation form was used for surveying the subjects' writing competence. The data were statistically analyzed by mean scores, standard deviation, percentage, effect size and t-test. The results were 1) English writing dexterity of undergraduate students at Thai-Nichi Institute of Technology was at good level, 2) the students' English writing dexterity after learning was significantly higher than before, with instruction constructed at 0.01 level, and 3) the experimental group's English writing dexterity was significantly higher than controlled group at 0.01 level.

articleTitle: Forecasting export value in the automobile industry
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The study aims to investigate the appropriate time series techniques for forecasting export values of cars and auto parts (Million Baht). The monthly data are gathered from the website of Ministry of Commerce from January 2010 to December 2017. The data are divided to two datasets. One dataset during January 2010 and December 2016 is consists of 84 observations which is used for build the forecasting model by using Winters' Additive Exponential Smoothing and Box- Jenkins. Another dataset between January 2017 and December 2017 are used for comparing forecast accuracy based on the lowest value of Mean Absolute Deviation (MAD) and Mean Absolute Percent Error (MAPE) and selecting the most appropriate forecasting model. The result shows that Box- Jenkins is the best method for this time series data.

articleTitle: Saving and investment behaviour of Gen Y workforce in Bangkok and Suburb
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Saving and investment is an important element for human life. There're various key factors that influence on saving and investment. Therefore, the objectives of this study are to investigate the factors which affect and have relationships with the saving and investment behavior of Gen Y workforce in the working age between 22-37 years old in Bangkok and its suburb, which is Samutprakarn, Nonthaburi and Pathumthani. The survey was conducted. The influences of the three groups of factors, defined as economic factors, motivation factors and learning factors were examined. It was found that Gen Y do not prefer the investment in high risk with financial products. On the other hand, they prefer to have the high liquidity investment. For the purpose of saving and investment, Gen Y aim at the retirement purpose. Also, the learning factors have the sole relationship with high risk asset and the size of saving and investment. Therefore, the learning factors, such as searching the financial knowledge and understanding financial assets clearly, can contribute to achieve the investment goals and help reduce the risk averse behavior in risky assets. With less fear and the understanding of the assets, they will increase the money for saving and investment. High risk with high return makes profits and wealth, and achieves the goal for retirement.

articleTitle: National economic benefits of circular economy policy
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The economic benefits of the circular economy policy are understudied. This paper shed light on the economic benefits of a circular economy in countries without resource scarcity problem. System dynamics method was used to overcome the data limitation problem. The results show that, although the investment cost is significant, countries will gain economic benefits in term of lower raw material costs in a long run. Because of that, products are accessible by a larger group which results in a higher sale volume.

articleTitle: Consumer responses to corporate social responsibility campaigns of automobile manufacturers in Thailand
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Nowadays Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) has become an important standard practice among large companies and trend of corporate social responsibility spending was continued to increase. The purpose of this research is to examine how consumers responses to CSR campaigns of Automobile Manufacturers in Thailand. Researchers conducted a survey research of 406 samples through valid and reliable questionnaires. Data were analyzed by using multiple regression analysis technique. Finding indicated that consumer respond to CSR campaigns vary across CSR campaigns. Implications and recommendations are discussed.

articleTitle: External barriers of energy management effectiveness by using reverse logistics with auto-parts industry in Thailand
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The purpose of this study was to investigate energy management effectiveness when reverse logistics was used in the auto-parts industry in Thailand and to examine external barriers that affected energy management effectiveness. Purposive random sampling was used to select the samples. The sample group was employees from 20 auto-parts industry companies consisting of 10 Tier 1 companies, 5 Tier 2 companies and 5 Tier 3 companies. The total number of participants was 1,120 employees. The research instrument was a 5-point rating Likert scale questionnaire. Cronbach's alpha was to measure internal consistency of questionnaire's items. The alpha coefficient of items was between .825-.971. Then the collected data were analyzed using SPSS for descriptive analysis and using Mplus for confirmatory factor analysis (CFA), and single level Structural Equation Modeling analysis (SEM). The results revealed that energy management effectiveness of using reverse logistics with the auto-parts industry in Thailand could be measured by three dimensions including cost (COS) with the factor loading at .919, time (TIM) with the factor loading at 0.814, and reliability (CON) with the factor loading at 0.766. The prediction power was 86.8%. The external barriers that affected that energy management effectiveness of using reverse logistics with the auto-parts industry in Thailand were: 1) pressure from government (COE) with the factor loading at 0.851 (COE); 2) pressure from customers (NOR) with the factor loading at 0.725; and 3) pressure from competitors (MIM) with the factor loading at 0.805.

articleTitle: Status of japanese held public company limited listed in The Stock Exchange of Thailand
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This research aimed to identify participation of Japanese FDI in The Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET). Researcher analyzed data collected from SET Market Analysis and Reporting Tool (SETSMART) including company profile, company highlights, historical trading, financial statements and dividend payment (as of 30 November, 2017). The Japanese group comprised 18 companies with market capitalization of 450 billion Baht accounted for 2.67% of total market. In this group, the first two largest sectors were financial and automotive. These companies have been in the business for more than 20 years, established the niche that helped sustain the revenue. The group average ROE was higher and leverage was lower than the market average, which could define them as cash-cow companies. Stocks of Japanese group had high dividend yield, low Beta and moderate P/E ratio compared with the market average. Whereas the stock turnover ratio were comparatively low. Researcher could classify their type as income stock, which could be an alternative for long-term investor for risk diversification and portfolio balancing.

articleTitle: Effects of university students' English speaking according to English instructional model based on communicative approach theory
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The purposes of this research were 1) to study English speaking ability of Thai-Nichi Institute of Technology students according to English instructional model based on communicative approach theory; 2) to compare TNI students' English speaking ability before and after speaking class; and 3) to investigate TNI students' satisfaction with the speaking class. The subjects were 55 undergraduate students at Thai-Nichi Institute of Technology during second semester of 2016 academic year which derived through simple random sampling technique. The instruments used in this experiment were the pre-post English speaking test, the lesson plans, the English speaking ability evaluation form, and the questionnaire on students' satisfaction towards the speaking class. The experimental process and data collection were conducted as follows: The subjects were given an English speaking ability pretest. Then, the four speaking lesson plans were used in second semester. After the completion of each lesson, the English speaking ability evaluation form, and the satisfaction questionnaire were used for surveying the subjects' satisfaction on speaking class. The data were statistically analyzed by mean scores, standard deviation, percentage and t- test for dependent samples. The results were as follows; 1. English speaking ability of Thai-Nichi Institute of Technology students was at high level. 2. The students' speaking ability after the speaking class was significantly higher than before, with instruction constructed at 0.05 level. 3. The students' satisfaction towards speaking class was at high level.

articleTitle: A study of ability in TOEIC test taking related to English speaking for communication of TNI students
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The purposes of this research were 1) to study the ability in TOEIC test taking of first year undergraduate students at Thai-Nichi Institute of Technology, 2) to study the ability in English speaking for communication of undergraduate students at TNI, and 3) to study correlation between the ability in TOEIC test taking and English speaking for communication of TNI students. The subjects were 70 first year undergraduate students in second semester of 2016 academic year derived through simple random sampling technique. The research instruments consisted of English language ability test and English speaking for communication test. The data were statistically analyzed by frequency, mean, standard deviation, and Pearson's correlation (r). The results of the study were as follows: 1) the ability's mean scores in TOEIC test taking of first year undergraduate students were 440 (out of 990), 2) the ability's mean scores in English speaking for communication of undergraduate students were 8.8 (out of 10), and 3) correlation between the ability in TOEIC test taking and the ability in English speaking for communication of TNI students was in the same way and there were statistically significant relations at 0.01 level.

Author Keywords: Ability in English Speaking for Communication

articleTitle: Comparative research between Japan and Thailand: A comparison of work motivation among young human resources
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The objective of this study is to investigate the work motivation of young human resources in Japan and Thailand. The difference of work attitude and motivation between Japan and Thailand were investigated by factor analysis. The participants were 100 Thai students from Thai-Nichi Institute of Technology and 100 Japanese students from Chiba Institute of Technology. The previous research showed that the factors which increase motivation of Thai and Japanese are different. In this study, the hypothesis intended to showed the motivation of Thai people was increased by extrinsic factors, such as rewards and punishments. However, it was found that the intrinsic factors for work motivation were more effective than extrinsic factors. Extrinsic factors were effective for the motivation for both Thai and Japanese. On the contrary, it can be supported that there are significant different between the purpose of work and work styles. It was considered that the different visions of their future work and social labor environment would be the cause of this difference.

articleTitle: Source sound determination in horizontal plane using human ears shape microphones
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Human ears play a major role in localizing the sound they hear. The pinnae, have a distinguished shape in each person and have significant impact on sound localization. The early study on sound localization, they have been used array of microphone to determine direction of the sound. There are studies that use only 2 microphones and can calculate the angle of arrival of the sound. But they cannot tell if the sound is coming from the front or the back of the microphone. To determine the direction and the location from the front or back, the pinna has been added to the microphone. This paper proposes the autocorrelation function (ACF) to determine the front or back location of the sound source. The frequencies are also used in the range of human speech with the pinna-shape microphone. The experimental results showed that the results of ACF give us the different patterns between the sound recorded from the front and sound recorded from the back side of the mannequin. Thus, the direction and location of front or back can be determine by the proposed method.

articleTitle: The development of production procedure and standard database for export declaration job: A case study of Thai Airways
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This paper is to improve the process of the export declaration (domestic) that happened at Thai Airways International Public Company Limited, in which the current system still encounters problems with the customs department. The reason is that there are no connections between the information base from the company and the customs department. The customs department lack of the latest information record, causing the problem. The problem is it takes way too long to do the export declaration jobs, which lasts from 58 to 60 minutes per day taking up 38 percent of the working hours at the Aircraft Manufacturing Shipping and Packing Department (TS-S). This results from the high frequency of the work procedure, which later is rejected by the customs department due to the fallacy in parts of the information such as the commodity code or the statistics code. So to solve this problem, the use of the technological communication system has to take part to create a connection between the company and the customs department to allow the same standards for the information base by using ECRS to combine the working process with the use of the program Microsoft Access and Microsoft Excel. This solution results in the less amount of time needed to get the process done, approximately 48 percent less or 27 minutes less. The company will then have a better standard of the export declaration jobs. The amount of the export declaration sheets drops 60 percent and the number of procedures will minimize to only seven steps from eight steps (12.5 percent decrease) and achieve to connect the information base between the company and customs department, moreover, it can lessen the failure rate and improve the work performance.

Author Keywords: the process of the export declaration

articleTitle: An analysis creative genre writing of Thai adolescent learners in terms of their knowledge of information reports genre
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This study concentrates on finding out the major strengths and problems of genre writing created by Thai adolescent learners. Information Reports is considered to be among the prototypical genres in educational settings. This genre would be the writing style Thai students would be able to do for reflecting their language ability including problems they have. Genre is the core approach assisting to analyze the learners' writing to determine genre writing strengths and problems. Referring to Halliday [9], this study also observes the ability of using nominal group based on Systematic Functional Grammar found in the genre writing. The findings illustrate that many Thai high school learners were able to construct the text at the level of the basic linguistic features of the genres. They are able to express their ideas, imagination and provide a lot of interesting information. However, they need to develop the nominal groups and adverb group for elaboration and expansion. These problems seem to be able to reflect what learners may not have chances to learn and practice in the classroom or lack of clear understanding.

articleTitle: Event detection in traffic observed by internet threat monitoring system by focusing occurrence probability matrices of correlation coefficient
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Internet threat monitoring (ITM) has been extensively performed by several organizations. To effectively analyze and grasp the trends of various security threats on the Internet, efficient analysis and event detection from traffic observed by ITM systems are desired. This paper reports the first attempt to adopt a network-state evaluation method which focuses on the occurrence probability matrices of the correlation coefficient of traffic observables for event detection in traffic observed by an ITM system.

articleTitle: Performance analysis of information technology application of inventory in manufacturing environments in cavite
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The study aimed to find out the inventory performance of information technology (IT) application in manufacturing environment in Cavite. The informational and operational processes are the unit of observation and the unit of analysis is the work efficiency, staff productivity, and inventory accuracy. The sample size of the study consists of one hundred fifty (150) manufacturing companies and employed purposive sampling techniques. The finding of the study reveals that the inventory IT application in terms of informational and operational processes is statistically significant to performance of inventory in manufacturing environment at 99.9% confidence level. The study discloses that the constant use of IT application improves the inventory performance. Any positive change and increase in the use of IT application affect the performance of inventory efficiency, staff productivity and inventory accuracy. However, the informational processes on performance reports and the operational processes on decision making should be given much attention to continuously improve the performance analysis of IT application of inventory in the manufacturing environment.

articleTitle: Importance of including practical machine learning application in the universities' curriculum
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: In this paper, we would like to discuss making the curriculum about practical machine learning application for university students. They increasingly motivated to learn about machine learning by the industrial request and their career plan. Applications of machine learning are released quickly, and the curriculum of university is insufficient in correspondence. We focus on an importance of including practical machine learning application in the universities' curriculum and discuss these issues in this paper. Specifically, we provide a perspective about the necessary in the front end and the back end technologies. Machine learning technology should be blended into the back end system, and the front end system like mobile interface is very important point as the quality of service for the user. Today, students necessary learn a lot of learning contents about the quality of service with amount of time. The issues at universities are the fusion of new topics and the existing curriculum and the economic costs balance. Also discussion is necessary for social cooperation with the industries. The method of STEM education is important for such the practical machine learning application curriculum. We discuss the examples and effects in Japan.

articleTitle: Model of social management innovation the empirical case study of Ratchaprasong District in Thailand
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Due to the constant change of information management system and technology, this article aims to propose a model of social management innovation, which paid attention to the interface between digital technology and CCTV-based data ("The Past"). The Thai public and private sectors have substantially invested in data collection and storage. Yet, there is still an unsystematic and unorganized process of management. The value creation from data analytics has been disconnected from a full participation of all relevant stakeholders. Particularly, CCTV-based data, which acts on behalf of human eyes and minds to monitor and insure safety and security of life and property in city areas, has been left unattended and unutilized. Most investors and governmental authorities have just followed a trend of installing CCTV, rather than fully taking advantage of their investment. By utilizing field work interviews, case study methods and reviews of the literatures, a model of social management innovation in this article indicates three important elements as inputs, throughputs and outputs. The inputs comprise of human activities, times and places. The throughputs require four components including big data, super software, highly qualified computers and artificial intelligence to process the interface between these digital technologies and the past. The outputs are happy societal communities resulting from reduced crime rates, corrective information and an intelligent city.

articleTitle: Mechanical performance of natural fiber reinforced composites produced by high-density polyethylene resin and rice straw
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Rice is the main product from agriculture in Thailand and its by-product is rice straw. The rice straw has a tendency to be used as a renewable fiber for preparing eco- material. The objective of this study aims to reduce waste from the agriculture and add the value into it by making the wood plastic composite. Therefore, this study aims to find the optimized parameters to improve the mechanical strength of the wood plastic composite made from rice straw and high-density polyethylene resin matrix. The wood plastic composite which is the environmentally preferable materials could be able to reduce the volume of natural wood. This study focused on the various ratio of rice straw and high-density polyethylene resin (10:90, 20:80, 30:70, 40:60 and 50:50). Besides the merits mentioned above, the wood plastic composite also has high environmental resistivity and longer lifetime. Furthermore, the wood plastic composite a prevents the problems from termites and insects which is often found in the natural wood material. The tensile strength of WPC was significantly reduced when the percentage of fiber increased to 50% but the percentage of water absorption increased depending on the percentage of fiber content.).

articleTitle: The comparison of weld metal with and without additional powder using submerged arc welding
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The hardfacing using submerged arc welding with additional metal powder has been a new way to extend the service life of the machine parts related to several wear mechanisms. Therefore, this research aims to compare the welding parameters of submerged arc welding which welded with martensitic steel wire without additional powder and low carbon steel wire with and without additional powders added to the weld metal. Then the macro and microstructure, chemical composition, welding dilution and the hardness of the weld metal were studied. The results presented that the weld metal of martensitic steel wire without additional powder showed martensitic and austenitic microstructure. Using low carbon steel wire without additional powder showed ferrite and pearlite microstructure. While the welding with additional powders, the microstructure depends on the type of metal powder used. These microstructures consist of ferrite with dense pearlite and ferrite mixed with martensite. In addition, it was found that the addition of metal powder to the weld metal reduced the dilution and increased weld metal hardness. However, both the microstructure and the hardness of the weld metal with powder addition are different from those of the weld metal welded with martensitic steel wire without powder addition.

articleTitle: Factors affecting the level of trust in mobile banking: A case study of customer perception toward commercial mobile banking adoption in Bangkok, Thailand
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The widespread use of smartphones in Thailand has led more consumers to conduct financial transactions and other banking activities on their mobile devices. However, consumer trust plays an important role in the development of long-term relationships in online environment between banks and its customers. Therefore, the purpose of this research was to identify the degree in which several influencing factors that affects trust of Thai consumers in mobile banking. A sample was selected from 336 cases were included as a sample by using purposive sampling method. The factors under this study include integrity, competence, benevolence, shared values, and security. Multiple Liner Regression was used for data analysis and quantitative method was applied in this research by conducting the questionnaire survey. The findings indicated that security is the most critical factor that affects customer trust in mobile banking followed by shared values and integrity respectively. However, competence and benevolence do not affect the level of Thai customers' trust in mobile banking with statistical significance at 0.05 level. Banks should provide service by highlight improving security in order to enhance trust of their customers and increase usage of mobile banking.

articleTitle: An experience advising senior projects spanning to multiple student generations
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This article describes an experience assigning real- world problems to a number of senior computer engineering students to work as their senior projects or capstone projects. The projects need special cares because they require many years to develop; therefore, they require multiple generations of students to finish the projects. In this paper, there are three of such projects working in parallel during 2016-2017 academic years. The project evaluation includes the project presentation, deployment, and the project's publications. We also collect the problems during the development. The results show that two of the student groups can complete the projects with excellent grade, and another one receives only a B grade. Two groups can generate three international or national publications. However, the students confront with many obstacles with real users, real organizations, and the multiple-year expansions. All of the theses cause difficulties to the process.

articleTitle: The factors influencing toward the decision of selecting the homestay of foreigners
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This survey research is aimed to investigate which factors has the influence the decision making to select the homestay of foreigners basis on seven aspects of service marketing strategies, namely; service product, service pricing, service distribution, marketing promotion, service staff or people, service environment and service process. The sample size consisted of 388 foreign tourists who selected to stay at homestay in Thailand. The samples were selected without any probability sampling. It is the "Accidental Sampling". A questionnaire was administered by using 5-point Likert scale method. Data was analyzed by using frequency, percentage, mean, standard deviation.

articleTitle: The effect of cultural dimensions on service quality expectations of the Thai restaurants: In case of Japanese customers
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The research focused on studying the effect of cultural dimensions on service quality expectation. Research methodologies used were mainly quantitative research, by collecting 300 questionnaires from Japanese consumers. The data was analyzed by descriptive and inferential analyses. The results showed that the most of Japanese customers' expected to service quality were Tangibles Assurance and Responsiveness respectively. However, Japanese customers expected a little level of Empathy. The results of hypothesis testing were summarized and reported. In summary, five cultural dimensions explained a significant R square of 0.55. The standardized regression coefficients revealed that LTO was the most influential predictor, followed by UAI, MAS and PDI respectively while, IDV is not a significant factor.

articleTitle: A survey to measure whether international business program (IB) course assignments are developing work skills at Thai-Nichi Institute of Technology
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This study measured the extent to which International Business Program (IB) course assignments are developing important skills that will be beneficial to students' IB careers after graduation. Seven different types of assignments were given to students in three IB courses taught by the researcher over a period of three semesters and a 5-point Likert scale survey was conducted to measure whether these diverse assignments are developing 5 selected IB skills: adaptability, creativity, teamwork, cultural empathy and English proficiency. The results show that well-designed assignments, namely a short story writing project about another country followed by organizing an event as a community to promote cross-cultural exchange, develop the highest amount of IB work skills on average.

articleTitle: Forecasting and purchasing planning for shelf life-limited spare parts
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Forecasting and Purchasing Planning for Shelf Life- Limited Spare Parts with a case study of company, purchasing spare parts from factories by selecting a forecasting method and applying a mathematical model. The purposes of this research are to improve the inventory quantity to be suitable for customers' demand, to reduce holding cost and to minimize the total inventory cost. In the past, the company operations didn't have purchasing planning strategy in the case study, the purchasing would be ordered when the inventory level is 0 that result shortage spare parts sometimes and the company had the policy about the spare parts with a limited 5-years lifetime. We propose a new strategy about applying a mathematical model for purchasing planning spare parts that minimize the total inventory cost by using a new safety stock (SS) and customers' demand that is the most accurate forecasting method with the lowest Mean Absolute Deviation (MAD) from 5 forecasting methods: 1) Moving Average, 2) Single Exponential Smoothing, 3) Double Exponential Smoothing, 4) Holt-Winters Smoothing, 5) Monte Carlo Simulation. Finally, the results of this study were found that the mathematical model for purchasing planning spare parts can prevent the inventory shortage problem, to reduce the quantity of expired spare parts and minimize the total inventory cost from the current purchases by 19.08%.

articleTitle: Improvement of the active textbook system
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Active textbook system is a novel educational supporting system. This system allows you to browse additional information by holding mobile devices over a general paper textbook. The system realize that teachers can attach additional information to the books relative easily, and students can use their own portable terminals to browse the contents. In this time, we have improved this system to higher functions.

articleTitle: The study of customer satisfaction towards the services of elderly cares business in Bang Khun Thian District, Bangkok
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This research aims to study customer satisfaction towards the services of elderly care business in Bang Khun Thian District, Bangkok. 108 sample were drawn by random sampling from family members and relatives of elderly patients at Warawan nursing home in Bang Khun Thian District, Bangkok. Questionnaires were distributed. Data were analyzed using frequency, percentage, mean (x ) and standard deviation (S.D.). The tool used in this research was questionnaire on satisfaction towards the services of Warawan nursing home in Bang Khun Thian District, Bangkok. The questionnaire can be divided into 3 parts i.e. Part 1 General information i.e. gender, age, educational level, occupation, income, and nationality, Part 2 Customer satisfaction towards the services of Warawan nursing home in Bang Khun Thian District, Bangkok, and Part 3 Suggestions of respondents. It can be concluded that most of the respondents are male, aged between 25 - 35 years old with bachelor degree. Most of them are private company employees with income 20,000 - 30,000 Baht per month. The majority of customers are satisfied with the services at Warawan nursing home in Bang Khun Thian District, Bangkok. Overall satisfaction is at good level. Considering each item, the item with the highest satisfaction level is routine care e.g. help removing clothes, help taking bath, help using toilet, and Encouraging self-help of the elderly. Overall satisfaction towards the cleanliness of the rooms for elderly is at very good level. When considering each item, the item with the highest satisfaction level is toilets are cleaned everyday, while the satisfaction towards the quality of food for elderly at Warawan nursing home in Bang Khun Thian District, Bangkok is at very good level. The item with the highest satisfaction is satisfaction on Warawan nursing home facilities.

articleTitle: Research on the cutting texture by turn-mill process
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: In recent years, turn-mill process using turn-mill complete machining centers have been attracting attention in difficult to cut materials processing such as aircraft manufacturing field. Turn-mill process can be machined at high speed and high efficiency; however, produced surface has a specific spiral texture and then has larger surface roughness. Therefore, there is a problem that can be used only for roughing. Also cutting parameters are so many, and influence on the processed surface is complicated. Therefore, there is few processing case report at present. In this study, to control a specific texture that appears on the cutting surface by using different types of cutting tools with adjusting many cutting parameters. Also the influence of cutting parameters on cutting texture is investigated.

articleTitle: A study of the factors influencing the design of daytime running lights using quality function deployment combine Kansei Engineering
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Automotive parts industry is the main of Thailand's economy including manufacturing, marketing, employment, technology development and they relate to other industrials. Nowadays, the customers can access to the information of products by many ways in order that the emotion of customers is the importance of developing the products. For the car, the Exterior Design is the first thing that the designer must be considered due to the exterior shape of the car has been highly influenced the customers and selling the cars. Recently, the exterior parts have significant increases of the demand for Thailand is Daytime Running Lights (DRL) because it can be reduced the accident on the road. Therefore, the objective of the present research is to propose for studying on the factors influenced the design of DRL. The method was using Quality Function Deployment (QFD) combine Kansei Engineering which it relates the emotion of the customers and the population sample was collected in Bangkok area. The results were performed that the customers concerned about the safety of the user and other people. In the Engineering Characteristic, the concerned point was about the Light type of DRL. The results of Kansei words were "luxury", "fresh light", "standard" and "international standard". Finally, the present research provided the concept design of DRL for line type and spot type.

articleTitle: Agribusiness system for developing of cultivators
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Myanmar is agriculture based country; therefore, agriculture is the vital point of developing trends in our country. According to this fact, to take the provisions for the online cultivators and estimate the profit for producing of the main crops, the effective agribusiness programs are necessary for reginal, national and global levels. To develop the business functions of agricultural environment, linear regression method is one of the statistical measures to be used in investments and finance. In this paper, the information about organic fertilizers can be obtained to support cultivation and help the online users. Moreover, if the online user wants to save the old investment and profit records, this user needs to register as a member. Thus, the system is suitable for cultivators and production manager or estimator to get the obtainable data such as profits and investments of last years. Furthermore, they can predict the future profit by adding current investment depending on old investment and profit records of the system using linear regression method.

articleTitle: Measuring efficiency of Thailand's football premier leagues using data envelopment analysis
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Football is considered one of the most popular sports in Thailand and has high influence on the nation economy. Thai Premier League is football competition at the top of Thai football league system. The objective of the paper is to evaluate both sportive and financial efficiency of football clubs in Thai Premier League during 2014-2015 football seasons with Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) model: CCR DEA and super- efficiency DEA. We consider three input factors: the stadium capacity, the capital Investment, the administrative expenses. Nine output variables investigated on the efficiency of football clubs are the number of supportive attendances, the total score in 2015, the total revenues, net assets, the number of trophies, the qualification for AFC for the last and the next season, the qualification for Thai Premier League for the last and the next season. The results show that two football clubs are not efficient. Later, it is found that both football clubs mentioned are relegated to lower league in the next competition 2016/2017. This evidence illustrates that super-efficiency DEA models can be successively to distinguish the efficient clubs and rank the football clubs in Thai Premier League.

articleTitle: The effect of an internship experience in Japan on Thai students' choice of employment
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The object of this paper is to assert, firstly, that desire to be employment at Japanese companies increases by experiencing internship in Japan, and secondly, that the students who did an internship in Japan will be more likely to find employment at Japanese companies. Despite the strong links between Thailand's and Japan's economic and industrial sectors, Japanese companies are often struggling to secure human resources in Thailand. This investigation focuses on whether the number of people who seek jobs in Japanese companies increase after an internship in Japan, and if yes what sort of company do students apply to. In addition, the trend of graduates of each faculty of Thai-Nichi Institute of Technology (TNI) was surveyed and compared with the trend of the students who experienced an internship in Japan to test the hypothesis that the latter has a stronger tendency to be employed by Japanese companies.

articleTitle: A development of EFL presentation skills by using the communicative approach for university students
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The purpose of this research was to develop EFL presentation skills by using the communicative approach for university students according to five components; preparation, organisation, content, presentation and oral skill. Research samples were 29 first-year students derived through a simple random sampling technique in the second semester of the 2017 academic year. The instruments used in this experiment included; a presentation evaluation form and a journal log of students' presentation performance. The experimental process and data collection were conducted as follows: The subjects were lectured in a series of presentation pedagogy to develop the presentation skills of the students. Then, a presentation of their choice was undertaken to assess the five components of the presentation criteria. A journal log was used for each student and a score given at the end of the class. The research result found that the overall presentation ability of the university students was at a moderate level.

articleTitle: Analysis of Japanese import - export market data for logistics case study of Eagles Air & Sea (Thailand) Co., Ltd.
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The competition between the logistic service providers is more intense and fluctuating demand of imports and exports products between Thailand and Japan. From the above causes, the number of customers who import products from Japan or export products to Japan decreased so total shipments and revenue of logistics service provider company decreases and lacks of confidence from the partnership and other customers for instance Eagles Air & Sea (Thailand) Company (the selected Case Study Company of this research). Therefore, this research purpose to analyst demand of Japan's imports and exports trend and increase total shipments and revenue of Case Study Company. This research present about compile and analyst essential information for create the standard platform which will be the tools when find new customers who import or export products between Thailand and Japan. In this research, apply Pareto to represent priorities of products as 80/20 Method. Moreover, analyst strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and threats about imports and exports products by SWOT Analysis. Summary new customers list and essential information after that transfer to Sales Team for contact to new customers and offer logistics service. As the result, total shipments of the case study company which belong to Japanese companies increase 46 shipments in December 2017. Revenue of the case study company which belong to Japanese companies in December 2017 increase 140,000 Bath from the previous month.

articleTitle: Motivation and loyalty of employees: A case study of automotive part company
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The purpose of this research is to study the loyalty of employees related to the motivation and hygiene factors. The company in the case study is a manufacturing company of automotive parts. The research samples were collected from 222 employees by using the questionnaires. The descriptive statistics and the inferential statistics were applied to analyze the motivation and loyalty data. The result of the research shows that the level of motivation factor is high with the mean of 3.99 scores while the level of hygiene factors is also high with the mean of 3.73 scores. Moreover, the loyalty level is also high with the mean of 3.98 scores. In terms of inferential statistics, it is found that the employees with different demographic background except the gender have significantly different loyalty level. Regarding the relationship between the motivation/hygiene factors and loyalty, the result indicates the positive correlation. Among the motivation factors, the work achievement is correlated with the loyalty the most. Among the hygiene factors, the relationship with supervisors is correlated with the loyalty the most. Therefore, the company policy and strategy for human resource management should be developed properly according to the associations found in the results.

articleTitle: Development of hexapod tracked mobile robot and hybrid motions for transportation
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The authors have devised a novel type of tracked mobile robot, hexapod tracked mobile robot, which is equipped with six legs attached to its body. This type of robot is able to not only move over rough terrain, but also perform a variety of handling tasks by using its legs as manipulator arms. A prototype of the hexapod tracked mobile robot was developed in this study. This paper describes an object transportation task with a traversing motion over a wide gap. Considering a sequence of the task, two motions are specifically described. One is the motion of picking up an object with hand-over between legs. Another is the motion of traversing a wide gap by a leg-tracks hybrid motion with object-carrying. Several simulations and experiments with the developed robot demonstrated its ability to achieve hybrid locomotion and tasks.

articleTitle: Motivation and problems of Thai staff in learning English at Thai-Nichi institute of technology
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Motivation has long been recognized as an important factor affecting language learning achievement. High motivated language learners tend to be competent language users. For that reason, the purposes of this study were to investigate the types and levels of Thai staff's motivation in learning English at Thai-Nichi Institute of Technology, Thailand; and to compare the levels of their motivation with their age difference and working experience. The participants were 23 Thai staff who attended in English for Effective Communication Course during August - September, 2017. The 25-item motivation questionnaire and open-ended questions were employed to collect the data. Then descriptive statistics, independent-samples T-Test, an analysis of variance (ANOVA), and content analysis were used to analyze the data. The findings revealed that Thai staff or adult learners had high level of motivation in learning English (M =3D 4.0). Instrumental motivation was ranked as the highest type of motivation (M =3D 4.36) whereas integrative motivation was ranked lower (M =3D 3.79). The highest instrumental motivation was English could help them broaden their knowledge (M =3D 4.69), followed by learning English could give them a sense of achievement (M =3D 4.65). Integrative motivation which the adult learners ranked the highest was English could help them keep in touch with foreign friends and acquaintances (M =3D 4.60). However, there were no significant differences among Thai staff's motivation, their age difference, and their working experience.

articleTitle: Study of Thai organizational commitment using a three-component model
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Recently, the concept of organizational commitment has received more attention as an important factor for organizational efficiency and the motivation of members. According to several previous studies, it is assumed that higher organizational commitment leads to better organizational efficiency and higher motivation among members. The concept of the relationship between individuals and their organization has received increased attention as an important factor for organizational efficiency and the motivation of members. The purpose of this study was to investigate the influence of national character on organizational commitment. Organizational commitment among students belonging to the Thai-Nichi Institute of Technology (TNI) was measured using a three- component model. It was clarified using the attributes of organization commitment of Thai by factors analysis. As a result, 6 factors were identified. The 6 factors were named based on the loading of each factor as Emotional affection, Value of belonging, Continuance awareness, Internalization consciousness, Reflection and Utilitarian consciousness. The output of 6 factors was plotted in 15 scatter diagrams. The results clearly showed the distinctive features of Thai people. Thus, the study supposed that creating a valuable organization for Thai characteristics is important.

articleTitle: Tone detection of Thai phonemes for home robot based on fundamental frequency analysis with dynamic time warping
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: In the near future, Thailand will become an aging society. Elderly person will live at home alone because the descendant must go to work at their office. So, their need an assistant from home robot for their daily life activity. Home robot needs command from user, so that speech recognition is needed. In order to process all time event without Internet, therefore embedded system is required. However, Thai language is tonal language which one word can be proposed as five tones. To understand Thai commands, home robot need to recognize Thai tones. In this research we focus on the development of home robot in service and recreation. The robot can manage the house, care for human beings, as well as friends and playmates. The home robot can interact with humans in many ways, such as a screen or a conversation. Humans have been communicating with robots for a long time in other languages such as English, Japanese and Chinese. In Thai language, the robot can communicate with humans as well, but it must be online and require high processing power. In this paper, we focus on offline processing and the use of low processing. This paper is one part of the speech recognition of Thai phonemes for home robot based on formants analysis with a neural network. The fundamental frequency is a major factor in the tone detection of Thai language. It will be presented by analyzing the equations called tone rules that represent the five tons, after that will compare it with test phonemes speech by using dynamic time warping. The experimental results showed that the tonal detection correct in Thai language as 88 percent.

articleTitle: The new era of language teaching: Case study of peer teaching method in German language class
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This article reviews the pilot study of peer teaching in German language class in the higher education, as well as examines the possibilities and limitations of its effects on students, their engagement and learning outcomes. Peer teaching is one of the practical methods promoting active learning in the classroom. Since explaining something to others forces the teachers to refine their own understanding, peer teaching makes learning more meaningful, deeper and longer lasting. After using the peer teaching method with the German major students in the course GR111 at Thammasat University, it has produced higher levels of active participation and greater learning, despite limitations from the uncontrollable variables.

articleTitle: Data analytics for service and operation management improvement in medical equipment industry
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The medical equipment industry in Thailand had been growing for decades due to increasing demand from aging society and patients from medical hubs and health-wellness centers. Many medical equipment manufacturers and producers were facing with competition from both domestic and international suppliers. The need to continuously provide service and operation management with stable processes became challenges facing medical equipment providers. The emerging technology, such as, data analytics were used to provide insight and intelligent information for management to make decision in managing and sustaining the business. The objective of this study was to study the benefits of the implementation of data analytics for stability and continuity of service and operation management improvement in medical equipment industry. The qualitative research methodology using case study approach and descriptive data analysis in selected medical equipment provider-company in medical equipment industry was used in this study. The results and findings with recommendations and limitation were summarized and presented in this paper.

articleTitle: Color information analysis that influence psychology on digital media design
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Color is considered as one of the important parts of digital media design that influences emotion. In fact, the design of digital media is related to many factors such as color, shape and composition. Almost all designs have different characteristics of color which can be described by using color image scale. The color image scale matches between colors and emotion keywords supported on digital media design. The objective of this research is to study and analyze the color information in order to apply for more meaningful of the design. There are totally 30 samples of design used in the experiment which consist of 3 groups; woman's, man's, and kid's products. The color of each design is analyzed by using k-means clustering to extract the representative color (RC). Then the RC result was compared with the color combinations in color image scale of Shigenobu Kobayashi to determine the meaning of emotion in each design. The evaluation was conducted by using the questionnaire survey to two target groups; expert group in graphic design and general group. The result shows that most respondents agree with the influence of color with the average score of 3.61. The average results for each product group from both expert and general respondents are all in the agreed level. Moreover, it was found that the color is more influential to female than male in the expert group. All of these results confirm in the psychological impact of color on digital media design.

articleTitle: Effects of communicative competency in English by using project based learning of undergraduate students in Thailand
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This The purposes of this research were 1) to study effects of communicative competency in English by using project based learning of undergraduate students at Thai-Nichi Institute of Technology, 2) to compare communicative competency in English before and after using project based learning of the students, and 3) to investigate the students' satisfaction towards project based learning method. The subject consisted of 30 first year undergraduate students at Thai-Nichi Institute of Technology during second semester of 2016 academic year which derived through simple random technique. The instruments used in this experiment included lesson plans, a project evaluation form, a communicative competency test, a student's self- assessment form and a satisfaction questionnaire. The experimental process and data collection were conducted as follows: The subjects were given a communicative competency pretest. Then, the 5 English communicative projects were used 45 hours in 12 weeks. After the completion of each project, a project evaluation form and a student's self-assessment form were administered to measure the subjects' English communicative achievement, and a questionnaire was used for investigating the subjects' satisfaction towards project based learning method. The t-test was employed to compare the subjects' English communicative achievement before and after using project based learning method. The mean and standard deviation of scores from the project evaluation form, the student's self-assessment form, and satisfaction questionnaire were used to measure at the end of instruction. The experiment lasted 45 hours. The results were 1) the students' communicative competency in English by using project-based learning was at high level, 2) the students' communicative competency in English after the project-based learning was significantly higher than before, with projects constructed at 0.05 level and 3) the students' satisfaction towards project based learning method was at high level.

articleTitle: Inventory reduction of requisition process in raw material warehouse: A case study of rice cooker factory
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Electrical appliance and electronics industry is an important industry in the Thai economy. Which is high export income, the exports increased rapidly and continuously. Considering the structure of the electrical appliances industry, Thailand is an important manufacturing base for multinational companies, especially Japan and South Korea which has resulted in the growth of electronics exports. The studied factory, which is in the electrical appliances industry. The researcher collected the data in the warehouse area where the parts were stored to wait for the assembly process. It is found that in requisition process, there are a lot of inventory (130,950 pieces) (the parts that are used for rice cooker model ABC-01 only). In the last November (2017), random sampling in the requisition process, the standard package (400 pieces/package) takes 12.42 minutes/set. And remaining package takes 32.25 minutes/set, it takes 2.6 times more than the standard package. From the current situation, the problems are the number of inventories exceed the demand and taking too much time in the requisition process, so the plan of countermeasures on the issue. Key response measures include the use of ECRS to eliminate unnecessary work and the creation of a standardized number of parts per package, tailored to fit the needs of the customer. As a result, the number of parts per package decreased by 4% / box, the number of inventory decreased by 3.08%, the taking time in the assembly process decreased by 62.05%, and the accuracy of the number of inventory is 99.80%.

articleTitle: Feasibility improvement of transportation for light rail train system
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: A single track train system generally follows a queuing model from end to end as trains generally falls in line from one station to the other then back. The effect of this model, as experienced in the Light Rail Transit (LRT) Train system, is waiting time to board train coaches take longer for passenger in the middle stations of the track since the first trains were already optimized during the first two to three stations. With the advent of researches in swarm intelligence applied to optimization problems. This research looks into a swarm of trains with a single objective instead of trains queuing on the tracks to load and unload based on range of frequencies. The research investigated using Poisson simulation an alternative Ant algorithm model applied to autonomous trains in the system as such improve the public service of transporting passengers. The research used the simulation data based from actual volume of use from the LRT line 1 system and will only focus on peak-hours experienced in the system.

articleTitle: Road traffic accidents severity factors: A review paper
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The deaths and injuries from traffic accidents are now the world phenomenon. Many countries all over the world, including in Thailand greatly concern about the growth of mortality and injury rate on the road. In 2016, there were 10,576 Thai people deaths as a result of road traffic accidents [16]. Moreover, World Health Organization (WHO) stated in 2016 that there were 20 to 50 million people suffered non-fatal injuries [19]. Understanding the factors affecting road traffic accident is an important area for a road safety research. The aim of this paper is to present the overview of factors influencing the road traffic accident severity and also reviews the techniques that frequently used in previous studies such as logistic regression, power model, and etc. From the review of literature, the mostly mentioned factors that are found to be significant to road traffic accident severity are speed of vehicle traveled, followed by human characteristics. Other factors that are found to be significant are vehicle types, weather, alcohol consumption, driver's fatigue, and etc.

articleTitle: A review of multimodal transportation optimization model
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The major component of logistic system is multimodal transportation. This paper presents the various alternative methodologies available to multimodal transportation planning. There is an application need for network modeling approach the optimization of people and freight transportation with different techniques. In the process of selecting the most efficient transportation modes, a multimodal transport costD model is used to demonstrate and clarify multimodal transport routing alternatives. Risk factors are also considered for each route, transport modes and nodal links. The goal of this paper is to review literature concerning a generic multi transportation network model based on implementation of computational techniques to increase efficiency.

articleTitle: A study on UI design of smartphone app for continuous blended language learning
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This study aims to develop a smartphone app which facilitates students to do their continuous language learning. It provides short but many different exercises as reviews for classroom lessons based on the microlearning. Currently, we have conducted a blended learning, which consists of both a face-to-face class and a home assignment in e-learning, for Chinese language courses. In this blended learning, we have provided a prototype of smartphone app "KoToToMo" with which students are able to practice by various exercises according to actual lessons in a class. However, we had found that the prototype app has some problems to be solved to perform effective practice based on the microlearning. This app just provides exercise, so students must remember chapters to be practiced and which exercises had been practiced. The students are also required many steps of operations to resume their exercisesfrom the point where they had halted their exercises. Therefore, in order to solve these problems of the existing app, we discuss effective user interface design of our app, which enables students to recognize the next exercises to be practiced by visualizing their progress of exercises and to select one from them in a few steps of operations.

articleTitle: Probabilistic learning models for topic extraction i Thai language
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Natural language processing (NLP) in Thai language is notoriously complicated. One major problem is the lack of word boundary in a sentence, introducing ambiguity in word tokenization. For topic extraction, semantic ambiguity adds another layer of complexity to the problem. Topic model that disregards word order, such as Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA), performs poorly in Thai Language. In this paper, we experimented and tested a probabilistic language model equipped with word location information, the so-called Topic N-grams model (TNG). We deployed several testing tasks to assess TNG's capabilities of modeling the generative process of Thai text and established benchmarks that compare the performance of LDA and TNG for various NLP tasks in Thai language. To our knowledge, this paper is the first to explore word-order model in Thai language topic extraction. We concluded that TNG can help boosting performance of Thai language processing in word cutting, semantic checking, word prediction, and document generation task. We also explored how we can measure performance of LDA and TNG on such tasks using perplexity.

articleTitle: The development of competency-based training course on expert coaching for senior vocational teachers in Laos
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This research aims to develop the competency- based training course on the expert coaching for senior vocational teachers in Laos. The vocational teachers have to utilize the effective learning and teaching method together with teacher's duties and responsibilities in their work. The paper described the approaches and opportunities of the evaluated course to train and provide the professional development training to senior vocational teachers. The training course covered the mass of experience, rationalized knowledge strategies, skills, and attitudes to be able to coach or help other colleagues in their field to perform their duties more efficiently. The competencies of the expert coaching have been analyzed and synthesized as follows: 1) coaching principles, 2) coaching development plan, 3) collaboration, 4) leadership, and 5) evaluation, feedback & support. The result found that the training course was accurate and appropriate at the high level and high correspondence in all items between elements of the training course and the behavioral objectives. The satisfaction and the agreement on this course can be considered to integrate into the Vocational Education Development Institute (VEDI) for the advanced training course and created the expert-coaching handbook as a learning guide for TVET teachers and interest persons.

articleTitle: Manufacturing information system using RFID technology
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The world is moving toward the next industrial revolution - Industry 4.0; consequently manufacturing enterprises have to prepare for becoming smart factories. The development of information systems for manufacturing enterprises is a crucial approach to increase productivities and to gain competitive advantages. This paper presents system analysis and design of manufacturing information system employing radio frequency identification technology (RFID) for real time information tracking for plastic product manufacture. According to the analysis, the manufacturing information system is composed of master data and four main modules which are production, ordering, searching and tracking, and report. The practical framework and design of RFID in production process are proposed together with main challenges for implementing RFID. Furthermore, the test is conducted to confirm the feasibility of RFID application.

articleTitle: Factors affecting the enjoyment of ERP software learning for non-IT learners
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: The learning enjoyment was previously discovered to have an influence on the perceived ease of use and usage intention of ERP software contributing to the learning achievement of non-IT learners based on Technology Acceptance Model (TAM) approach. The present study was extended from the previous one for the purpose of examining the factors affecting the learning enjoyment. The samples were collected using the questionnaire in the ERP class of business students (non-IT learners) at Thai-Nichi Institute of Technology. The structural model was tested by the method of Structural Equation Modelling (SEM). Three constructs of learning enjoyment are derived from three perspectives, which are the learners' self-efficacy, the learner-ability-based teaching style of the instructors and the relaxed learning environment. From the data analysis, the valid model reveals that only the learners' self- efficacy has significantly a direct effect on the learning enjoyment while the other two constructs don't have. However, the teaching style of the instructors has a significant effect on the learners' self-efficacy, indicating that the ability-based teaching style has an indirect effect on the learning enjoyment through the learners' self-efficacy as a mediator. Consequently, the non-IT learners can perceive the learning enjoyment as they can build their self- efficacy in using ERP software while the instructors play as supportive roles to assist the non-IT learners. The significant factors found in the study can be practically considered to enhance the software training effectiveness in the company.

articleTitle: Assessing symptoms of excessive SNS usage based on user behavior: Effective factors associated with addiction components
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Excessive Social Networking Site (SNS) usage leads to negative consequences that are associated with addiction. We assessed the symptoms of excessive SNS usage by studying user behavior in SNSs. Understanding how people behave in them helps detect and identify the symptoms of excessive SNS usage. In our previous studies, we developed a data collection application and experimentally collected data from undergraduate students in Thailand. We employed modified versions of Internet Addiction Test (IAT) and Bergen Facebook Addiction Scale (BFAS) for measuring SNS addiction. Our results identified the differences between excessive and normal users. In this article, we clarified the factors associated with addiction components reflected by IAT and BFAS question items. Our analytic results indicated the effective factors for addiction components.

articleTitle: The impact of career satisfaction, commitment and supervisory support on organizational commitment of Thai Employees: A study in Japanese subsidiaries
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This empirical study focus on work motivation literature by investigating the impact of career satisfaction, career commitment and supervisory support as antecedents of organizational commitment in order to address solutions for severe turnover problem among Thai workforces who work in foreign subsidiaries. Hypotheses were tested on data from 135 full-time Thai employees of Japanese subsidiaries. The results of this study show that career satisfaction, career commitment and supervisory support correlated significantly with organizational commitment. Additionally, younger employees were likely to perceive less commitment to their organization. More importantly, the findings indicated that, career satisfaction, and commitment and supervisory support also predicted organizational commitment. A discussion of the current findings highlights the combination of management practices in relation to employees' career path, socialization process and constructive supervision for human resources retention from the early stage was also addressed.

articleTitle: DHEA: A dynamic hierarchical edge architecture for a participatory approach toward IoT evolution
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: In recent years, Internet of Things or IoT has been enjoying a very rapid growth. However, traditional approach toward IoT deployment requires specialized knowledge where issues are handled by an individual or a group of individuals and is not participatory. In addition, it is being recognized that with the fast increase in the number of objects connected to the IoT, the centralized cloud based management scheme is bound to lead to inefficiencies. In this paper, we propose a new generation IoT platform called KIBAN which is based on openness and adopts a participatory approach toward deployment of IoT. We also propose a novel hierarchical architecture called Dynamic Hierarchical Edge Architecture or DHEA to overcome the potential issues with the centralized cloud based approach. We describe how KIBAN could be realized using the DHEA architecture. Because of the layered structure of KIBAN, it is possible to easily implement part of the platform even on gateways with low computing capabilities. Experiments show that such implementation can lead to a two times faster response time compared with that in a cloud based system.

articleTitle: Emotions and intentions mediated with dialogue acts
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Recently, there is an increasing interest in affective computing approaches where the complex interplay of the speaker's intentions and emotions is analyzed and used to direct various human interaction processes. The presented study is an attempt to further investigate along these two social cognition- regulating dimensions, mapping dialogue acts, which are pragmatic-level units representing intentions of the speaker, to emotions. The mapping is achieved by annotating transcriptions of in-game Japanese conversations with tags of basic emotions and dialogue acts exemplifying the social context. A statistical analysis of the emotion-dialogue act co-occurrences reveals several dependency patterns, where certain dialogue acts (and, therefore, the underlying intentions) are associated or disassociated with one or more emotions. Results obtained are discussed, conclusions are drawn, and plans for future work are formulated at the end of the paper.

articleTitle: Factors affecting secondary school students' decisions towards studying in vocational school in Lao PDR
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: A technical workforce is an essential need in Lao PDR as proposed by the government. However, the lack of vocational students to support the labor market is essential. This research aims to identify factors affecting students' decisions towards studying in vocational education in Lao PDR. The samples were 300 students studying in grade 9 and 12 in the academic year 2017. The students were from northern part, central region, and southern part of Lao PDR. The instrument was a questionnaire. Data analyses were frequency, percentage, mean, and standard deviation. The results showed that students were keen to study in the university more than the vocational school. In addition, the personal attribute factor had the highest effect to students' decisions. They believed that studying in vocational school could gain more theoretical knowledge and advanced practical training. This research can reflect the related stakeholders to uplift the vocational education standard and enhance the image and credibility of vocational schools in the future. The research findings can stimulate the Technical and Vocational Education Department to plan for an appropriate national policy, and create strategies to increase student enrolment in the vocational education.

articleTitle: HDLRuby, a new high productivity hardware description language
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This paper presents HDLRuby, a new hardware (HW) description language aiming at increasing the productivity of HW designers. Contrary to state of the art approaches that try to synthesize HW from software-like models of computation, HDLRuby sticks to the register-transfer level whose synthesis results remain unparalleled. The gain in productivity is thence achieved by the introduction of paradigms that prove to be successful with recent software (SW) programming languages, but are independent from the model of computation. For that purpose, the HDLRuby framework has been implemented as a library of Ruby, a SW programming language famous for its high productivity and plasticity. A case study is also presented that shows how HDLRuby makes it possible to describe tedious HW parts using only a few clean lines of code.

articleTitle: Route prediction in air travel network using socio-economic factors and learning models
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: Air-travel route services are significant since airlines must serve routes to meet air travel demand to maximize profits. This paper proposes route prediction models using socio-economic factors. Route prediction is considered as classification problem in machine learning. Three learning methods: logistic regression, support vector machine, and neural network are used to predict existing or non-existing routes in United States. The experiments show that neural network model provides better performances than the other two methods. The findings of predicted routes can be analyzed further for route addition and deletion, in order to assist airline business in making decision to serve their passengers better.

articleTitle: Multidimensional perspectives on readiness in dual cooperative training at Lao-German technical college for heavy equipment program
publicationTitle: 2018 5th International Conference on Business and Industrial Research (ICBIR)
abstract: This research aims to investigate the readiness of the Dual Cooperative Training (DCT) program to be used as a guideline for the future implementation in the DCT project particularly in the heavy equipment field at the Lao-German Technical College (LGTC). The study examined the facilities and conditions of the LGTC and enterprises by focusing in Vientiane area in Lao PDR. The target groups were five executives and five teachers at the LGTC, and ten managers and ten trainers from medium and large private and public enterprises by using the interview questions. The results found that almost the respondents agreed on the cooperation DCT program. The setting program criteria included the preparation of the workshops, materials, tools and equipment. In addition, the LGTC and enterprises were satisfied with the DCT concept which can be implemented in the future. The positive results of this research can ensure the readiness of the forthcoming DCT program in the heavy equipment field at the LGTC.
